body: Built on a Ford Transit Trail 148 EXT, this fully custom camper van was designed for adventure, comfort, and ultimate off-grid capability. Engineered with 800Ah lithium-ion batteries, a 400W solar system, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, this van delivers reliable power no matter where the road leads. With multiple 110V outlets, USB-A & USB-C ports, and shore power connectivity, staying charged and connected is effortless—whether you're working remotely or streaming from the Starlink high-performance satellite system.

Designed for year-round travel, this build includes premium insulation, a gasoline-powered Espar heater, and a 12V Nomadic air conditioning unit, ensuring a comfortable interior in any climate. The interior is crafted for both function and style, featuring painted shiplap walls, a wood-stained ceiling, recessed LED lighting, and durable vinyl flooring. A unique feature of this build is the integrated kitty condos, designed specifically for the owner's cat. These custom-built spaces provide a secure and cozy retreat, ensuring feline companions have their own dedicated area to rest and observe the world outside. The custom bench seating also includes pass-throughs for the cat, blending pet-friendly design with modern convenience.

The fully equipped kitchen features an acacia butcher block countertop with an insert cutting board, a double burner induction cooktop, a stainless steel sink, a Zuvo water purification system, and an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with a freezer. A 700W microwave and a fold-down exterior table add even more versatility for cooking and dining on the go. The wet-bath includes an indoor tiled shower, a customer-provided toilet, and an electric greywater dump system, making off-grid living seamless.

Built for rugged travel, this overland-ready camper van features a roof rack with a side ladder, an electric awning with integrated LED lighting, an exterior perimeter lighting package, and a forward-facing light bar wired to the Transit Trail AUX switch panel. The van is also outfitted with Owl Vans and FVCO gear, including a B2 bike carrier, 1UP bike trays, an expedition box, and a spare tire carrier, ensuring it’s equipped for any adventure.

Every detail of this Ford Transit camper van conversion was thoughtfully designed for life on the road. If you're looking for a fully custom adventure van that meets your exact needs—whether for you, your dog, or even your cat—reach out to us today to start designing your dream build.
